name: Layout Content Lock Release
description: automatically releases content locks when saving content in Layout Builder.
project_description:
This module is built for sites using Content Lock and Layout Builder, where users often forget to unlock content or are left on the same edit screen after saving. It saves editors from having to manually click “Unlock” and confirm the action, reducing friction and saving time during content updates.

 Improves the content editing experience by automatically releasing the content lock after saving via Layout Builder, and redirecting the user to the View page of the node they just edited.
